_comment: SECRET MILESTONE REWARDS - Do not reveal to players!
_description: Players who complete enough quests with specific NPCs earn secret companion rewards

Victor.reward_description: A massive grey dire wolf emerges from the forest. It regards you with intelligent eyes, then sits at your feet. Victor's wolf pack has accepted you as one of their own.
Victor.announcement: 🐺 **SECRET UNLOCKED!** A Dire Wolf has chosen you as its companion!
Victor.npc_reaction: *Victor's weathered face breaks into a rare smile.* The wolves... they see something in you. This one won't leave your side now. Treat it well.

Elowen.reward_description: A warm glow emanates from Elowen's tower. A small phoenix, trailing embers like falling stars, flutters down and lands on your shoulder. Its warmth is comforting, not burning.
Elowen.announcement: 🔥 **SECRET UNLOCKED!** A Phoenix Hatchling has bonded with you!
Elowen.npc_reaction: *Elowen gasps, her eyes wide with wonder.* Oh my... I've never... The phoenix chose YOU! They only bond with those pure of heart. This is... this is extraordinary!

Flicker.reward_description: The shadows around you shift and giggle. A tiny sprite made of living darkness peeks out from behind your ear. Flicker seems almost jealous.
Flicker.announcement: ✨ **SECRET UNLOCKED!** A Shadow Sprite has attached itself to you!
Flicker.npc_reaction: *Flicker buzzes excitedly around your head.* Oh oh OH! A cousin! You got a cousin! They only come out for the REALLY fun ones!

Bran.reward_description: Bran slides a worn leather journal across the bar. Inside are recipes for dishes that grant powerful buffs - his family secrets, passed down for generations.
Bran.announcement: 📖 **SECRET UNLOCKED!** Bran has entrusted you with his family recipe book!
Bran.npc_reaction: *Bran leans in close, his voice low.* You've been good to this place. Good to me. These recipes... they've been in my family for seven generations. Use them well.

Garron.reward_description: Garron's massive form goes still. Slowly, reverently, he removes his own hammer and holds it out to you. It hums with ancient power.
Garron.announcement: 🔨 **SECRET UNLOCKED!** Garron has gifted you his Master Hammer!
Garron.npc_reaction: *Garron's voice is quieter than you've ever heard it.* This hammer... it was mine. Before. When I was... more. It knows good work. It knows good souls. It belongs with you now.

Merchant.reward_description: The Merchant frantically digs through his cart, then triumphantly holds up a small, cobbled-together droid. It beeps, whirs, and immediately starts organizing your inventory.
Merchant.announcement: 🤖 **SECRET UNLOCKED!** The Merchant has given you a Mini Scrap Droid!
Merchant.npc_reaction: *UTINNI! UTINNI UTINNI!* *The Merchant hops up and down, pointing at you, then at the droid, chattering excitedly. He seems genuinely emotional.*

Takoda.reward_description: Takoda reaches into the smoke of his fire and pulls out something that shouldn't exist - a dreamcatcher woven from starlight and stories. It shows glimpses of other worlds.
Takoda.announcement: 🌙 **SECRET UNLOCKED!** Takoda has woven you a Dreamcatcher of Many Worlds!
Takoda.npc_reaction: *Takoda's ancient eyes twinkle.* You have listened well, young one. The stories have noticed. This dreamcatcher... it catches more than dreams. It catches possibilities.

Phoenix Hatchling.bonus: +2 to all magic rolls, auto-revive once per day
Phoenix Hatchling.description: A creature of rebirth and flame

Shadow Sprite.description: A playful creature of living shadow

Bran's Secret Recipe Book.bonus: Unlocks secret recipes with powerful buffs

Garron's Master Hammer.bonus: +5 to all crafting rolls, can repair anything

Dreamcatcher of Many Worlds.bonus: Can glimpse other worlds, +3 to lore rolls
